module_summary: Motor-control Moore FSM: after reset pulses f, watches x for a 1-0-1 sequence, then asserts g and checks y within two cycles to latch g permanently on or off.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Controller state register sequencing A, B, x-detect, y-check and permanent states

anchors.name: f
anchors.why: One-cycle motor control output decoded from state B after reset

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: Motor control output decoded from G1, G2, P1 states

groups.name: motor_fsm
groups.description: FSM detecting x sequence and y response, decoding f and g
